title: Join without a usable index
sql: SELECT c.city, o.status FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.city = o.status LIMIT 100;

title: Group by
sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;

title: Sort and limit
sql: SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 10;

title: Subquery
sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE amount > 990);

title: Zero rows
sql: SELECT o.id, c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.amount > 5000;

title: Full pipeline
sql: SELECT c.city, SUM(o.amount) AS total FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.amount > 100 GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY total DESC;

title: Slow showcase
sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status LIKE '%deliv%' ORDER BY created_at DESC;
